label: RER G alone
about: Only RER G of the plan: line P joined to line N by Nord-Est, Chatelet-Les Halles and Montparnasse. Times from the study: Nord-Est to Saint-Lazare 4 minutes and Nord-Est to Montparnasse by Chatelet 9 minutes, stops included (model TR.SL, TR_G); TER 11 minutes between two Paris stations, a 5-minute stop included (TR_TER). The new platforms take the walking times that the timetable gives today for the suburban platforms of the same station, and 5 minutes to those platforms themselves (ASSUMPTION); 3 minutes between two groups of new platforms in one station, as between two lines of one station today (ASSUMPTION).
